title.narrative: FONDATION FORUM DE BAMAKO 2024: Bamako Forum
FONDATION FORUM DE BAMAKO 2024: Bamako Forum

description.narrative: Forum Bamako is a yearly event with the purpose to analyse, disseminate and debate new research finding and methods to address Mali's peace and security challenges.
Forum Bamako är ett årligt evenemang syftar till att analysera, debattera och publicera nya forskningsrön och metoder för att hantera Malis freds-och säkerhetssproblem.

The objective of this intervention is to promote analysis, dissemination, dialogue and debate based on research findings relating to the theme: Culture, Reconciliation, Peace and Development. Furthermore, the Forum will provide an opportunity to share experiences and lessons learnt in Africa and elsewhere in the world with regard into the chosen theme. It will provide up to date information and allow for the sharing of best practices among decision makers and practitioners, with a focus on actors in West Africa.
The themes for the panel debates of the 2024 edition are (approximately translated from French): 1. Civilizations and modern states in West Africa 2. Culture, inter community conflicts and violence 3 African and national identifies and the future 4. Culture production and the economy 5. Education and culture 6. Cultural diplomacy 7. Financing cultural public policy 8. Technological revolution, culture and art

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative: The Forum de Bamako 2024 has succeeded to mobilize more than 300 people and that the media coverage has been substantial. It has been a great opportunity for Sweden as well as Swedish funded partners to convey messages regarding peace, security, development and reconciliation to a wider audience, including policy-makers in Mali and in the region.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
